shared_elements: relief carving of a creature against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces show an animal-like creature carved in relief, but that is where correspondence ends: A is a densely filled, flat, outline-and-infill composition of interlaced ribbon beasts, a horse with riders and framing plaited borders arranged in stacked panels on a shaped slab, while B shows a single large, three-dimensionally modelled animal in high relief with a projecting rounded head and incised parallel grooves, isolated on the surface. The rendering conventions (planar graphic interlace vs. volumetric sculptural modelling) and the compositional schemes have nothing specific in common.
